accepted_limitations: PhotoPrism is the currently cataloged runtime app; cross-app coverage grows from the same contract.
known_gaps: Application-owned media indexing is not a Pocket Lab parity authority.
items.label: Apps
unsupported_operations: Restore apply and update apply remain unavailable unless separately implemented and validated.

accepted_limitations: Heartbeat freshness can move during capture; comparison records the observed revision.
known_gaps: Per-device profile fields remain partial when the agent has not published them.
items.label: Devices
unsupported_operations: Healthy online devices are not removed without explicit confirmation.

accepted_limitations: CPU, memory, and storage presentation may be rounded or unit-formatted.
known_gaps: Live runtime semantic evidence remains explicit and release-bound.
items.label: Home
unsupported_operations: Home never executes system operations directly.

accepted_limitations: Credential values are never observable parity fields.
Identity guard and protected server-host authority fields are planned and may remain unavailable until identity bootstrap services are implemented.
known_gaps: The current tab is direct-rendered and has no dedicated selector layer.
Identity guard and protected server-host projections are not fully implemented.
items.label: Identity
unsupported_operations: Identity mismatch repair/rejoin must remain explicit and fail closed.

accepted_limitations: Status labels intentionally use Lite-friendly wording instead of raw backend enums.
App restore apply remains explicitly unsupported where the repository reports it unavailable.
Historical restore previews are evidence only and never authorize a new restore.
known_gaps: Live Termux and live browser semantic capture remain explicit; missing capture is not drift.
items.label: Backup & Restore
unsupported_operations: Unsafe writes remain disabled while the recovery projection is stale.

accepted_limitations: The current product contract is a protection-mode policy surface, not a general arbitrary rule engine.
known_gaps: Per-rule identity and execution history are planned, not present in the current API.
items.label: Rules
unsupported_operations: Planned trigger/condition/action automation is not marked verified.

accepted_limitations: Raw scanner output and sensitive paths are intentionally excluded.
known_gaps: A missing scanner is runtime-unavailable, not semantic drift.
items.label: Security
unsupported_operations: The browser never runs Lynis, Trivy, shell, PM2, or NATS commands.
